_fare_record.source: M2M Ferries published Mumbai Ferry Wharf/Bhaucha Dhakka ↔ Mandwa Ro-Pax fare floor: passenger fares from ₹400 onwards; motorcycle ₹210 onwards; 4-wheelers ₹1,020 onwards; buses ₹4,500 onwards; vehicle deck over 120 cars/two-wheelers/buses. Converted at ~INR85/USD: ₹400 ≈ $4.70. This is a direct fare floor/comparable, not a premium Navier fare claim.
_fare_record.method: Direct on-market public water-transfer fare floor only; not inserted as premium comparable fare. Premium Navier fare must be separately sourced before finance publish.

_demand_record.method: Market anchor split after sealed route count captured; M2M fare floor unchanged.

observed_load_anchors.captured_metric: Belapur→Mandwa average ridership of 120 passengers; DCT had hardly any passengers; 200-seater NAYAN XI; fare ₹400 lower deck / ₹450 upper/business.
Belapur→Elephanta filling 80% capacity on 32-seat vessel with three round trips; Belapur→JNPT doing very well; DCT→Mandwa 60 round trips in 10 days with <10% passengers on 200-seat vessel.
Belapur jetty connects DCT, Nerul, Belapur, Elephanta and JNPT; enables Bhaucha Dhakka, Mandwa, Elephanta and Karanja movements.

_fare_record.method: Modeled from Maldives premium resort speedboat per-seat comparable (R5 greenfield; R12 short luxury transfer not flight-substituted).

_demand_record.source: Red Sea Global / The Red Sea destination capped at 1,000,000 visitors/yr at full completion 2030 across 50 resorts/8,000+ keys (RSG official; Monaco Yacht Show factsheet 2025; blooloop; ICWA). Shura Island hub->outer-island resorts is THE primary internal transfer leg; R3 discount ~50% (not all resorts outer-island; some mainland/nearshore) -> ~500k 1-way.
_demand_record.method: Destination visitor cap (T1/T2) x R3 on-corridor discount. 2030 build-out target.
